record.context_brief: Lifting free independence with uniform k-independence
record.original_question: If u,v are freely independent unitaries in the ultrapower N^U, can they be lifted to sequences of unitaries in N that are pairwise k-independent for every k?

evidence.quote: Problem 31. Suppose u, v ∈ NU are freely independent unitaries, then can they be lifted to sequences of pairwise k-independent unitaries in N for all k?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N$ be a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with separable predual and faithful normal trace $\tau$, and let $\mathcal{U}$ be a free ultrafilter on $\mathbb{N}$. Form the tracial ultrapower $N^{\mathcal{U}} = \ell^{\infty}(\mathbb{N}, N)/\mathcal{I}_{\mathcal{U}}$, where $\mathcal{I}_{\mathcal{U}} = \{(x_n) : \lim_{n \to \mathcal{U}} \tau(x_n^* x_n) = 0\}$, equipped with the trace $\tau_{\mathcal{U}}([(x_n)]) = \lim_{n \to \mathcal{U}} \tau(x_n)$.

Recall that elements $a_1, \dots, a_m$ in a tracial von Neumann algebra $(M,\tau)$ are said to be free (freely independent) if the unital $*$-subalgebras they generate are free with respect to $\tau$ in the sense of Voiculescu. For an integer $k \geq 1$, two unitaries $x, y \in M$ are called $k$-independent (or free up to order $k$) if for every alternating product $w$ of length at most $k$ formed from centered powers $x^{n_1} - \tau(x^{n_1})$, $y^{m_1} - \tau(y^{m_1}), \dots$ with $n_i, m_i \in \mathbb{Z} \setminus \{0\}$, one has $\tau(w) = 0$.

Suppose $u, v \in N^{\mathcal{U}}$ are freely independent unitaries. Do there exist representing sequences $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ and $(v_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of unitaries in $N$ with $u = [(u_n)]$ and $v = [(v_n)]$ such that, for every integer $k \geq 1$, the unitaries $u_n$ and $v_n$ are $k$-independent in $(N,\tau)$ for $\mathcal{U}$-almost every $n$?
artifact.category_tag: Ultraproduct II_1 factors and free independence
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a recent compilation of fifty open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors (2025). A web search did not surface any solution; related works on lifting free independence and on commuting Haar unitaries in ultrapowers address adjacent but distinct questions. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Internal Sequential Commutation and Single Generation
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses lifting unitaries in M^U with prescribed commutation/independence properties; treats lifting commuting Haar unitaries to lifts in N.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses lifting problems for unitaries in ultrapowers of II_1 factors but does not establish lifting of free independence to pairwise k-independence for all k.

status_evidence.title: Connes embedding problem: A guided tour
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing free independence in ultraproducts of tracial von Neumann algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys free independence results in ultraproducts; does not resolve the stated lifting question.
